title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornographic videos of Dutch public figures were created and posted to an online platform without consent. The videos used generative AI to superimpose the faces of entertainers, athletes, government officials, and members of the Royal Family onto pornographic content. The platform monetized these videos by paying users based on view counts, creating financial incentive for their creation and distribution.

This is a failure of platform governance and content moderation at the point of deployment. The system accepted and promoted sexually explicit synthetic media impersonating real people without verification that the subjects had consented. The failure occurred before videos reached viewers, at the upload and curation stage where a human review process or synthetic media detection system could have prevented distribution.

It is not established whether the platform operators knew about the illegal content, whether they took any steps to detect deepfakes before monetizing them, or what specific mechanisms if any they used for content review.

summary:
Multiple female Dutch celebrities are considering legal action after discovering themselves in manipulated pornographic videos posted on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature the faces of Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former government officials, mayors, and members of the Royal Family superimposed onto pornographic content. Justice Minister Yesilgöz described the videos as disgusting and urged victims to file complaints. Several victims have already filed reports or are exploring legal options.

These deepfake pornographic videos are created by placing a person's head onto an adult film actor's body. The platform encourages anonymous uploads and pays users based on video views, likely to avoid prosecution. Legal experts warn that without government intervention, more fake videos will emerge. Deepfakes fall under revenge porn laws and are punishable offenses. Victims can file police reports, which may lead authorities to shut down the website, or pursue other options including mass lawsuits and complaints to data protection authorities. Previously, presenter Welmoed Sijtsma was victimized and created a documentary series about her experience, resulting in a 39-year-old man receiving a conditional 180-hour community sentence in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
